notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have another botanical patch for you all!

This patch includes a small amount of fixes:

* If you're holding an item when saving, you'll still be holding the item when you later load the game.
* Added a fix for disappearing items, and any previously disappeared items will be in the spot they were placed.

Have a great Tuesday!

The Botany Manor Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hey botanists! We’re so happy to see you all enjoying Botany Manor!

Thank you all for communicating and reporting issues, we have fixed up a bunch and listed them below. Please understand we are a very small team and are still addressing other issues, which will roll out in due time.

Full list of fixes:

* Replaced ‘move up’ with ‘move down’ on the tower lever.
* Added a collider to the kitchen wall so the interaction dots of the scale weights don’t see through.
* Some localisation fixes.
* Make sure saving doesn’t happen while sitting down, causing a potential locked player state on resuming the game.
* Fix a typo in the letter from Arabella’s sister in the Flower Room.
* Fix a typo on the squirrel card in the Boat House.
* Make sure the letter lock is correctly localised in Traditional and Simplified Chinese at the start of the game.
* Trigger the plant growth achievement after growing a plant, so players with missing achievements can trigger it even after completing the game.
* Added a chapter select to main menu, so you can easily restart/replay a chapter. This should help currently soft-locked players while we work on more fixes.
* Fix an issue where the Formal Garden key would be missing when resuming the game, if it was not picked up in previous session.

notes.title: Small Launch Patch
notes.notes:
* Prevent players from exiting the tower while it's going up, causing them to soft lock the game.
* Make sure the game doesn't autosave on resuming in main menu, overriding their save data.

notes.title: Botany Manor Out Next Week — New Video Shows Off Pixie Tears
notes.notes:
Hello fellow botanists! 

There are only a few more days before you’ll get to explore the grounds of Botany Manor! Just before we launch on the 9th of April, Balloon Studios' creative director Laure De Mey has put together a new video, taking you through one of the enchanting puzzles you’ll encounter.

Pixie Tears are one of the rare forgotten flora that retired botanist Arabella Greene has collected as part of her long years of research. Like many of the plants in her collection, this specimen requires a very specific set of circumstances in order for it to bloom. Laure walks us through Arabella's research collection to determine just how to make this mysterious flower flourish. 

You can learn more about the Pixie Tears by watching the video below (spoiler alert!):

notes.notes: I've always thought that the best way to relax is to look after something small, and for me, that would be my plants. It's been over a year since I moved into my flat, and before I even had a sofa, pots and pans, or a bed frame, I made sure to cover every inch of every room with flowers, vines, plants, and herbs... notes.title: An Introduction to the Clues That Will Help You Bloom Forgotten Flora
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow botanists!

As we prepare for the glorious gardens, graceful greenhouse, and dignified doors of Botany Manor to open, we wanted to reveal a special look at some of the clues you’ll need to seek out in the beautiful manor in order to help Arabella Greene bring long-forgotten flora into full bloom!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43187138/5cb6e735b6c8a24c68cb6c515057957ff698935f.png[/img]

Arabella’s stunning historical English homestead is filled to the brim with a lifetime of memorabilia and research just waiting for you to uncover and explore. As you uncover the long-forgotten seeds she intends to research, you will need to explore the manor in search of these clues to help her determine the precise conditions required to help each rare plant grow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43187138/194bf97dd30d29f6ca644d1a648fd98861ce05bb.png[/img]

Some of these clues will come in the form of books, letters, postcards, poems, and assorted other pieces of botanical research and scientific data, including cell samples, charts, and much more. With each new clue you uncover, you’ll be able to piece together the puzzle to bring each flower to its full growth. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43187138/f9ca0eaff7edde4c97513a7153ceae4cc8f9bd6b.png[/img]

Each clue is interactable; by turning bottles, examining both sides of letters or postcards, and turning the pages of books, you’re invited to thoroughly investigate each item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43187138/4fd0faf0a81a0764550a792da33a43ee990c0614.png[/img]

As clues are discovered, you can document them in your very own herbarium that you can access at any time as you uncover the mysteries surrounding these plants.

We hope you enjoyed this brief introduction to some of the clues you’ll find in Botany Manor! We’ll have more things to show and some big announcements in the coming months, so if you’d like to stay up-to-date we’d love it if you would drop us a wishlist, and follow us on [url=https://www.twitter.com/BotanyManor]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/botany_manor/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@botanymanor]TikTok[/url].

notes.title: Steam Demo and New Trailer for Botany Manor Revealed During Wholesome Direct
notes.notes:
Today we are excited to reveal the first look at Botany Manor, as during Wholesome Direct, we announced its first Steam demo!

If you're eager to get your hands on Botany Manor - you're in luck!  Starting today until June 19, you can explore the manor and help Arabella research the unique way to make each flower flourish. We hope you enjoy it!

We also presented a brand-new trailer during the showcase, which offers the first look at the Herbarium, a book that documents botanist Arabella Greene’s research into the mysterious plants she uncovers, and an essential tool to help you track the clues discovered to solve each puzzle. You’ll also get a sneak peek at four of the flowers from the game: Windmill Wort, Fulguria, Phoenix of the Forest, and Sapphire Gloom.

In case you missed Wholesome Direct, you can catch the new trailer here: https://youtu.be/AMHBEg9cogM

Thank you for all your support, and if you enjoyed the demo, don’t forget to wishlist the game!
